Enrich terrain in one tap — adjustable, with preview
Pick a preset, or chain a few “modifiers” yourself (e.g. Natural edges → Ford → Trees). Each step can be tuned, turned off or reordered.
Check the preview, apply when happy
Areas around spawns and pools are protected by default. Afterwards, land routes between spawns are checked and a ford corridor is opened if blocked.
Tap “Generate 4 variants” to pick your favorite side by side.
To change only one area: box-select it, then tick “Selection only”.
Save a good combination as “My preset” or copy a share code for others.
On what terrain, how far from what, place what
Each rule: on a terrain, within a distance of another terrain (optional), place an item or change terrain with a probability. E.g. “on grass, 3–6 tiles from water, place trees, 30%”.
Follow the style of a map you like
Pick a map you like; the editor measures how much decor each terrain has and how wiggly the edges are, builds a set of modifiers and applies them to the current map.
Pick an effect (natural edges, decor, erosion, smooth, relief, clear decor, war scars) and brush it on the map. More control than changing the whole map.
Raise and lower like sculpting hills
Hold and brush to raise ground step by step: deep water → water → shallow → sand → grass → dirt → cliff highland; switch to “Lower” for the reverse. Each stroke is one step.
First paint “this is forest, that is desert”
Paint areas with the biome brush (forest, grassland, desert, snowfield, swamp, volcano, wasteland), then tap “Generate by biome”; the editor fills in matching terrain and decor with natural borders.
Drag along the route you want: trees and rocks on it are cleared, river crossings become fords; optionally pave land as dirt road.
